title: keyrotation renewal residual
summary: Security keys are rotated at renewal times with independent identically distributed intervals X. Historical intervals have E[X]=10 days and E[X^2]=200 days^2. An auditor arrives at a uniformly random stationary time, not at a rotation epoch, and needs the expected time until the next rotation. The variability of rotation intervals must be accounted for; simply taking half the mean interval is not accepted.
